concerns.text: FR-005 and US-2 acceptance scenario 3 require evaluation on the held-out VALIDATION set with metrics 'consistent with the cross-validation estimates (within ±0.05)'. T005 instead computes 'metrics on the held-out test set ... and on the training set' and checks 'test metrics are consistent with CV estimates within ±0.05'. The validation-set evaluation mandated by FR-005 is silently replaced by test-set evaluation — a semantic narrowing the deterministic FR-012 check will not catch. Add a validation-set metrics output (e.g. data/results/val_metrics.json) and run the ±0.05 CV-consistency check there.

T006 permits 'if exceeded, reduce the fixed representative training subset' — narrowing FR-001/FR-009, which require ingesting and processing the full USPTO dataset (batched to stay within RAM), and contradicting the spec assumption that training 'on the full dataset ... will not exceed the specified runtime limit'. The plan's Fixed Representative Subset is documented, but the spec was never amended to permit subsetting the TRAINING data. Either amend the spec to sanction a documented subset or restrict T006's fallback to streaming/chunking, not training-data reduction.

T002 hardcodes `datasets.load_dataset("farama/USPTO_Yields", split='train')` while the spec assumes 'downloaded using wget' from a DOI and the plan says 'canonical HuggingFace URLs'. Three artifacts name three different ingestion mechanisms for the same canonical-source reproducibility requirement (Constitution I). Tasks should state which artifact is authoritative (or the spec/plan should be reconciled) so the canonical source is unambiguous.
